breaking.change: UI tween transitions and eased keyframes use the shared GSAP Ease names; EaseName is removed without aliases.
breaking.fix: Use none for linear. Preserve the former out, exit and inOut curves with bezier arrays [0.23,1,0.32,1], [0.4,0,1,1] and [0.65,0,0.35,1], not approximate GSAP names.

fixed.summary: UI motion, widgets and style curves use the deterministic shared timing evaluator; style steps no longer become linear transitions. Style roles remain indirection, and CSS keeps its own authored timing vocabulary.
